name: 05-ceph-cluster
title: The Ceph cluster
description: Grow the bootstrapped cluster to the ebook's full storage design, orchestrated from the physical host: podman/LVM on ceph-02 and ceph-03, the cephadm public key published to both, hosts joined, monitors pinned to the management network with client I/O on the MTU-9000 storage-fe network and replication on storage-be (set before any OSD exists — daemons bind at creation), a three-monitor quorum, six explicitly-claimed OSDs, pools rbd-prod (size 3) and rbd-dev (size 2) both RBD-initialised, and a client.cloudstack cephx identity scoped to exactly those two pools — never client.admin.
source: Generated from runbooks/lab/lab-ceph-cluster.yaml in the MatrixClaw lab repository. That runbook built this phase of the real 32 GB estate on 20-21 July 2026; the run records hold every command's exit code and output.
honesty: Steps change this machine and are gated. Each carries an 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what is done rather than repeating it. Checks are read-only and carry exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text.

steps.title: Peer prereqs
steps.run:
for ip in 22 23; do
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.$ip "sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y podman lvm2"
done
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.22 'dpkg -s podman 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s lvm2 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed' && ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.23 'dpkg -s podman 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s lvm2 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed'

steps.title: Publish cephadm key
steps.run:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph cephadm get-pub-key" > /tmp/ceph.pub

for ip in 22 23; do
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.$ip \
    "sudo mkdir -p /root/.ssh && sudo tee -a /root/.ssh/authorized_keys > /dev/null" < /tmp/ceph.pub
done
rm -f /tmp/ceph.pub
echo CEPHADM-KEY-PUBLISHED
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.22 'sudo grep -q ceph /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null' && ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.23 'sudo grep -q ceph /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null'

steps.title: Join ceph 02 03
steps.run:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch host add ceph-02 10.100.99.22"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch host add ceph-03 10.100.99.23"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch host ls"
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch host ls' | grep -q ceph-03

steps.title: Set networks before osds
steps.run:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph config set mon public_network 10.100.99.0/24,10.200.99.0/24"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph config set global public_network 10.200.99.0/24"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph config set global cluster_network 10.201.99.0/24"
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph config dump 2>/dev/null' | grep -q '10.201.99.0/24'

steps.title: Mon quorum three
steps.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch apply mon --placement='ceph-01,ceph-02,ceph-03'"
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph mon stat' | grep -q ceph-03

steps.title: Create six osds
steps.run:
for h in ceph-01 ceph-02 ceph-03; do
  for d in vdb vdc; do
    ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch daemon add osd $h:/dev/$d"
  done
done
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd stat' | grep -q '6 osds'

steps.title: Pools rbd prod rbd dev
steps.run:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool create rbd-prod"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool set rbd-prod size 3"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool create rbd-dev"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool set rbd-dev size 2"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- rbd pool init rbd-prod"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- rbd pool init rbd-dev"
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool ls' | grep -q rbd-dev

steps.title: Scoped cephx client
steps.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 "sudo cephadm shell -- ceph auth get-or-create client.cloudstack mon 'profile rbd' osd 'profile rbd pool=rbd-prod, profile rbd pool=rbd-dev' >/dev/null" && echo 'CEPHX-CLIENT-CREATED (key retrieval: ceph auth get-key client.cloudstack, interactively, on zone day)'
steps.already: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph auth get client.cloudstack >/dev/null 2>&1'

checks.title: Three hosts in cluster
checks.run: test "$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph orch host ls' | grep -c 'ceph-0')" -eq 3 && echo THREE-HOSTS-OK

checks.title: Three mons in quorum
checks.run: test "$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph -s' | sed -n 's/.*quorum \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' | tr ',' '\n' | grep -c .)" -eq 3 && echo QUORUM-3-OK

checks.title: Six osds up in
checks.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd stat' | grep -o '6 up'

checks.title: Health ok
checks.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph health'

checks.title: Pools present
checks.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool ls' | tr '\n' ' '

checks.title: Rbd dev pool present
checks.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool ls' | grep -o rbd-dev

checks.title: Cloudstack client exists
checks.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'sudo cephadm shell -- ceph auth get client.cloudstack >/dev/null 2>&1' && echo CEPHX-SCOPED-CLIENT-OK
